title: Option pack manifest (pack.yaml)
description: One pack implements one catalog option. See docs/adr/0002-option-packs-and-slots.md.

option.description: The catalog option this pack implements, as <dimension>.<option>.

files.description: Files this pack owns outright. No other pack may write to these paths.

slots.description: Contributions to extension points other packs or the base declare.

declares-slots.description: Extension points this pack opens for others.

agents.description: Rules for agents working in a generated project that chose this option.

agents-md.description: Section appended to the generated AGENTS.md.

briefs.description: Additions to individual agent briefs, keyed by role.

adr.description: Template of the ADR recording this choice in the generated project.

gates.description: Checks that fail a generated project's build when this option's rules are broken. At least one.

template.description: Path inside the pack, rendered with Scriban.

target.description: Path in the generated project; may use {{ module.name }} for per-module files.

per-module.description: Render once per module that chose this option.

order.description: Tie-breaker inside the slot; lower renders first. Ties sort by option id.

separator.description: Joins the contributions; a newline when absent. JSON lists need ",\n".

describes.description: The rule this gate enforces, in one sentence.

file.description: Template providing the gate, if it is a file.
